q: Which payment methods are growing fastest this month compared to last month? Show percentage growth.
sql: SELECT payment_method, COALESCE(((SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(transaction_date AS DATE) >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(transaction_date AS DATE) < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) AND CAST(transaction_date AS DATE) >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) - 100), 0) AS growth_percentage FROM silver_transactions WHERE CAST(transaction_date AS DATE) >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '2 months') AND CAST(transaction_date AS DATE) < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 month' AND payment_method IS NOT NULL AND amount IS NOT NULL AND quality_flag = 'PASS' GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY growth_percentage DESC;

q: Which 5 merchants have the highest refund rate? Show refund count and total transaction count.
sql: SELECT m.merchant_id, m.merchant_name, SUM(CASE WHEN st.status = 'REFUNDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refund_count, COUNT(st.transaction_id) AS total_transaction_count, (SUM(CASE WHEN st.status = 'REFUNDED' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(st.transaction_id), 0)) AS refund_rate FROM merchants m JOIN (SELECT transaction_id, status, merchant_id FROM silver_transactions WHERE quality_flag = 'PASS' AND CAST(transaction_date AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE) AND CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY transaction_id, status, merchant_id) st ON m.merchant_id = st.merchant_id GROUP BY m.merchant_id, m.merchant_name ORDER BY refund_rate DESC LIMIT 5;
